records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Mileage Plan other revenue increased $14 million, or 4%, in the first six months of 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Passenger revenue for the second quarter of 2024 increased $53 million, or 2%, on a 2% increase in passenger traffic, partially offset by a slight decrease in yield.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The $14 million improvement was driven by higher passenger revenue consistent with the increase in traffic, partially offset by higher operating expenses associated with increased capacity.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total operating expenses increased $74 million compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the first six months of 2024, cash provided by operating activities was $872 million, compared to cash provided by operating activities of $832 million in 2023.
